readme: Every entry carries a source. An entry whose source starts with 'TODO' is provisional and reduces the confidence of any snapshot that uses it (CLAUDE.md 8.2). An entry with a null value is not known at all, and a model that needs it refuses to run rather than guessing. Full bibliography in docs/agronomy/sources.md.

gddBaseTemperature.source: Sands, P.J., Hackett, C. & Nix, H.A. (1979). A model of the development and bulking of potatoes. Field Crops Research 2:309-331. Base temperature of 7 C, the basis of the widely used potato P-day formulation.
gddBaseTemperature.note: Widely reproduced in potato phenology literature. Verified as the conventional base temperature; not measured for Andean cultivars.

gddUpperTemperature.note: An upper cut-off caps the contribution of hot days. No value verified for this crop and region, so growing degree days are accumulated without a cap and the limitation is recorded instead of papered over.

kcInitial.source: Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D. & Smith, M. (1998). FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56, Table 12 (Roots and Tubers, Potato).
kcInitial.note: The HTML edition leaves the Kc ini cell blank for potato; it inherits the group value 0.5 printed at the head of the Roots and Tubers block.

kcEnd.note: FAO-56 footnote: about 0.40 for long season potatoes with vine kill. This file keeps the table value; vine kill is not modelled.

rootingDepthMin.source: FAO-56, Table 22 (Roots and Tubers, Potato): Zr 0.4-0.6 m.

rootingDepthMax.source: FAO-56, Table 22 (Roots and Tubers, Potato): Zr 0.4-0.6 m.

depletionFraction.source: FAO-56, Table 22 (Roots and Tubers, Potato): p = 0.35.
depletionFraction.note: Average fraction of total available soil water that can be depleted before the crop is stressed.

stageLengthInitial.note: Provisional: FAO-56 Table 11, potato, continental climate, planted May (25/30/45/30, total 130 days). FAO-56 publishes no row for the Peruvian Andes, so the region does not match and the value needs agronomic review.

stageLengthDevelopment.note: Provisional: FAO-56 Table 11, potato, continental climate, planted May.

stageLengthMid.note: Provisional: FAO-56 Table 11, potato, continental climate, planted May.

stageLengthLate.note: Provisional: FAO-56 Table 11, potato, continental climate, planted May.

gddToEmergence.note: Thermal time from planting to emergence. No value verified for Andean cultivars; inventing one would feed every downstream stage with a number that looks measured.

gddToTuberInitiation.note: Thermal time from planting to tuber initiation.

gddToBulking.note: Thermal time from planting to the start of tuber bulking.

gddToMaturity.note: Thermal time from planting to maturity.

soilFieldCapacity.note: Provisional: FAO-56 Example 36 uses theta_FC 0.32 for silt, a medium texture. The actual texture of the farmer's plot is unknown, so the published value is applied to a soil it was not measured on. A per-plot soil property should replace this.

soilWiltingPoint.note: Provisional: FAO-56 Example 36 uses theta_WP 0.15 for silt. Same caveat as soilFieldCapacity.

leafWetnessHoursWhenDewObserved.note: Hours of leaf wetness to assume when the farmer reports wet leaves in the morning. No published mapping from a qualitative observation to a wetness duration was found, so the Wallin model runs only when a weather source supplies real leaf wetness hours.
